testimonials.quote: I cannot thank Sulay enough for helping me get my writing career off to a great start. As an editor, she knew exactly how to improve my work with insightful pacing comments, thoughtful plot critiques, and spot-on character analyses.
testimonials.author: Boyd Morrison
testimonials.work: Author of The Ark, The Midas Code, and The Loch Ness Legacy

testimonials.quote: I loved working with Sulay! Her passion, energy, and intelligence made this creative journey for me a joy.
testimonials.author: David Alan Grier

testimonials.quote: Sulay Hernandez helped my first novel, Final Theory, become a great success. Her editorial advice improved the manuscript immensely. Thanks to her enthusiasm and guidance, I achieved the dream of every first-time author.
testimonials.author: Mark Alpert

testimonials.quote: I felt safe with Sulay. That's the best way I can describe it. I felt like I — and my words — were safe with her.
testimonials.author: Aliya S. King

testimonials.quote: Sulay is the greatest thing that could have happened to me since I started writing my novel. She has the gift, the love and the knowledge to make any manuscript the best it can be.
testimonials.author: Rebeca Gomez Galindo

testimonials.quote: Sulay was absolutely instrumental to the success of my book. Her dedication and understanding of my story made it possible for her to work on my project while I was in a state prison. She is an amazing editor.
testimonials.author: Prodigy of Mobb Deep

testimonials.quote: Sulay Hernandez understands that publishing is a business and writing is an art, and she seamlessly navigates each world and builds bridges between them. She's courageous, honest and savvy.
testimonials.author: Matthew Goodman

testimonials.quote: Working with Sulay Hernandez was a privilege. Her editorial notes were insightful, clear, and true to my characters. She not only improved my books, but also gave me the tools to become a better writer.
testimonials.author: Nora McFarland
testimonials.work: Author of A Bad Day's Work

testimonials.quote: Sulay Hernandez is a dream boat editor. She is fearless, sensitive, with exceptional vision and taste. Working with her on my debut novel was a peak experience.
testimonials.author: Leslie Daniels

testimonials.quote: Sulay recognized something special in Prodigy's story and connected the dots to make our collaboration possible. She saw the strength in his raw self-expression and didn't shy away from controversial subject matter.
testimonials.author: Laura Checkoway
testimonials.work: Journalist & co-writer of My Infamous Life

testimonials.quote: I often think of Sulay on my book writing journey. I have her to thank for so much of it. She believed in me and that made all the difference.
testimonials.author: M. L. Doyle

testimonials.quote: Nowhere did I find a more thoughtful, clear and patient editor than Sulay Hernandez. She let me own my work, my revisions, the final product. And yet her insights and wisdom were key to ensuring the complicated aspects of the memoir could be salient and succinct.
testimonials.author: Luis J. Rodriguez
testimonials.work: Author of It Calls You Back
